subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should this PR fail closed on official ClawHub provenance for legacy or bare records while adding trusted channel docs metadata, or should older official records be repaired/preserved first?
rationale: The code change is technically coherent, but the acceptable trust boundary and upgrade behavior for existing official ClawHub installs is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Require repair before merge
options.body: Add or point to a doctor/update repair path so older official ClawHub records regain trusted official status without reinstalling.

options.title: Accept fail-closed behavior
options.body: Land the stricter provenance gate as-is and accept that older bare records lose official sync/drift/docs treatment until users reinstall or repair manually.

options.title: Pause for #98875
options.body: Hold this PR until the npmSpec-only official ClawHub trust fix is resolved so both rules land with one consistent boundary.

recommendation.title: Require repair before merge
recommendation.body: Add or point to a doctor/update repair path so older official ClawHub records regain trusted official status without reinstalling.

likelyOwner.reason: They own recent cross-surface onboarding direction and can arbitrate the setup UX and trust-boundary tradeoff with adjacent plugin owners.
